verdict.rationale: The SDK runs an autonomous agent loop that repeats tool calls until the task is complete, with no manual intervention (docs-50, docs-32). Permission modes pre-authorize actions so runs don't block on approvals (docs-55), and production hosting on Docker, Kubernetes and sandbox providers supports long-lived background processes (docs-11, docs-26). A community user corroborates building a full headless automated workflow on `claude -p` (comm-4). Missing for 10: no built-in scheduler or event triggers (cron, webhooks), so users must wire up triggering and hosting themselves; background-session management (agent view) is documented for Claude Code rather than the SDK itself.
